title: Fix token refresh race condition in OAuth2 middleware
description: When multiple requests hit the refresh endpoint simultaneously, the middleware could issue duplicate tokens. This PR adds a lock to serialize refresh operations.
patch_diff:
diff --git a/fastapi/security/oauth2.py b/fastapi/security/oauth2.py
--- a/fastapi/security/oauth2.py
+++ b/fastapi/security/oauth2.py
@@ -45,6 +45,15 @@
+    async def serialize_token_refresh(self, token: str) -> RefreshResult:
+        async with self._refresh_lock:
+            existing = await self._cache.get(token)
+            if existing and not existing.is_expired:
+                return existing
+            new_token = await self._provider.refresh(token)
+            await self._cache.set(token, new_token)
+            return new_token
test_diff:
diff --git a/tests/test_security_oauth2.py b/tests/test_security_oauth2.py
--- a/tests/test_security_oauth2.py
+++ b/tests/test_security_oauth2.py
@@ -102,6 +102,28 @@
+    async def test_concurrent_refresh_no_duplicates(self):
+        results = await asyncio.gather(*[refresh(token) for _ in range(10)])
+        assert len(set(r.token_id for r in results)) == 1
